description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dolphins OC Bobby Slowik labeled Chris Bell as "still a long ways away."
items.impact: Bell opened training camp on the non-football injury list. He is working his way back from a torn ACL.
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) 'long ways' from returning

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed CB Fabian Moreau.
items.impact: Moreau was previously drafted by Washington in 2017. He was on the Vikings practice squad last season.
items.title: Fabian Moreau signs with Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks waived WR Kyre Duplessis.
items.impact: Duplessis signed with Seattle last week. He will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Kyre Duplessis waived by Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed LB Garrett Nelson.
items.impact: Nelson spent time on practice squads in both Denver and New Orleans last season. He will compete for a depth role in the Seahawks linebacker room.
items.title: Garrett Nelson signs with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns waived OT Jack Conley.
items.impact: Conley will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Jack Conley waived by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns signed CB Tyler Hall.
items.impact: Hall appeared in one game with the Seahawks last season. He will compete for a depth role in the Browns secondary.
items.title: Tyler Hall signs with Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans placed wide receiver DJ Turner on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury.
items.impact: Turner signed with the Texans on July 29 and practiced Monday. His season will end on injured reserve, or the Texans will reach an injury settlement with him and release him.
items.title: DJ Turner placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys TE Princeton Fant has a torn ACL and partial MCL tear.
items.impact: It is a brutal break for Fant who suffered the injury during practice. He is expected to undergo surgery in the next couple of weeks.
items.title: Princeton Fant suffers torn ACL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots released TE Jeremiah Franklin.
items.impact: Franklin will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Jeremiah Franklin released by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots claimed WR Tejhaun Palmer off waivers.
items.impact: Palmer was waived by the Cardinals. He Will compete for a depth role in the Patriots wide receiver room.
items.title: Tejhaun Palmer claimed off waivers by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers have placed DL LaBryan Ray on the reserve/retired list.
items.impact: Ray played 46 games the past three seasons, including 10 starts. He was not at practice on Tuesday for personal reasons.
items.title: LaBryan Ray retires from NFL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers signed WR Elijah Cooks.
items.impact: Cooks spent the spring in the UFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Panthers wide receiver room.
items.title: Elijah Cooks signs with Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers signed WR Roc Taylor.
items.impact: Taylor spent the spring in the UFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Panthers wide receiver room.
items.title: Roc Taylor signs with Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers waived-injured WR Ainias Smith.
items.impact: Smith will figure to seek another opportunity once he is cleared.
items.title: Ainias Smith waived by Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers waived WR Gabriel Benyard.
items.impact: Benyard signed with Carolina last week. He will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Gabriel Benyard waived by Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns waived WR Aaron Anderson.
items.impact: Anderson will figure to compete for a spot in another team's training camp.
items.title: Aaron Anderson waived by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns claimed defensive tackle Coziah Izzard off waivers.
items.impact: Izzard was waived by the Cardinals. He will compete for a depth role on the Browns defensive line.
items.title: Coziah Izzard claimed off waivers by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said JuJu Smith-Schuster sat out Giants practice on Tuesday with swelling in his knee.
items.impact: It is not ideal for Smith-Schuster as he compete for a depth spot in the Giants wide receiver room.
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster (knee) sits out practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Lions waived WR Lawrence Keys with an injury designation.
items.impact: Keys will figure to seek another opportunity once he is cleared.
items.title: Lawrence Keys III waived by Lions

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alijah Clark left practice early on Tuesday with an ankle injury.
items.impact: Clark will be further evaluated. There should be an update on his status later in the week.
items.title: Alijah Clark (ankle) leaves practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jonathan Bullard is dealing with sore hamstrings.
items.impact: Bullard has been limited in training camp. He signed a one-year contract with Dallas back in free agency.
items.title: Jonathan Bullard dealing with hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown did not participate in team drills on Tuesday due to sore legs.
items.impact: Overshown is among the many players being eased into training camp. It doesn't appear he is dealing with a serious concern.
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (leg) absent from team drills Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Guyton was limited during practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Guyton is working through a sore elbow. It doesn't appear to be too serious.
items.title: Tyler Guyton (elbow) limited in practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers signed TE Drew Biber.
items.impact: Biber signs with Green Bay as an undrafted free agent.
items.title: Drew Biber signs with Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers signed TE McCallan Castles.
items.impact: Castles spent the second half of last season on the Packers' practice squad. He was waived in April and now returns to Green Bay during training camp.
items.title: McCallan Castles signs with Packers

title: Fantasy Player News
